findings.source_quote: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb –Exodus 3:1.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider using a more idiomatic Italian rendering of “the backside of the desert.” The current translation uses «Il retro del deserto», which is understandable but slightly literal. Suggest: «la parte posteriore del deserto» or «lato posteriore del deserto» to sound more natural in contemporary Italian. Preserve the surrounding tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Ora Mosè pascolava il gregge di Ietro, suo suocero, sacerdote di Madian; e condusse il gregge dietro il deserto, e venne al monte di Dio, a Horeb –Esodo 3:1.

findings.source_quote: A broad desert valley beneath layered mountains and clouds
findings.suggested_fix: Alt text is translated and accurate, but could be made more idiomatic and fluent in Italian. Suggest: «Una vasta valle desertica sotto montagne stratificate e nuvole» to match register and natural phrasing. Edit only the alt attribute value.
findings.translation_quote: alt="Una ampia valle desertica sotto montagne stratificate e nuvole"
